correctness.rationale: The pair coordinate P_{r,s} enumerates all unordered pairs without duplication, with a shortened even antipodal layer. Absorption is almost sure by bounded merging words. The first-moment Bellman equation and second-moment equation 2U=4T-2+U(Pa)+U(Pb) uniquely determine finite solutions; the explicit Y_r,B_{r,s},K_r potentials satisfy ordinary, exceptional, top-layer and phase-zero equations for both parities. Summing polynomial potentials over the exact pair counts yields the global polynomial. Independent Markov matrix inversion in exact rationals n=2..8 reproduced both moments, including n=2 U=6. These finite checks test, but do not replace, the symbolic all-n parity calculation.

value.rationale: Pair merging under random input is a fundamental stochastic synchronization observable on a canonical difficult family. The exact second moment and persistent nonvanishing coefficient of variation capture fluctuation severity absent from expected-time and worst-pair analyses.

final_claim: For n≥2 classical Černý automaton with iid fair a,b and uniform independent unordered initial pair, E tau=(n-1)(2n²+n-4)/3, E tau²=(16n⁶-32n⁵-16n⁴+66n³-15n²-87n+52)/15, Var tau=(28n⁶-76n⁵+47n⁴+68n³-130n²-61n+76)/45, CV→sqrt(7/5).
limitations: Fair independent inputs and uniform unordered initial pair only; no all-state reset time or biased-input law.
Scientific proof has not been checked by formal Lean or expert attestation.
